name: Mandelic Clear Intensely Revitalizing Cream | Advanced Brightening & Dark Spot Care
description:
Transform your skin with Mandelic Clear Intensely Revitalizing Cream. This advanced formula helps brighten your complexion, smooth skin texture, and reduce the appearance of dark spots and dullness. Designed to promote a radiant, even-toned, and healthy-looking skin surface, it is an ideal solution for achieving a luminous glow.
Key Features:
 Brightens and evens skin tone
 Smooths rough or dull skin texture
 Reduces the appearance of dark spots
 Promotes radiant and healthy-looking skin
 Suitable for daily use for men & women
 Revitalizes and refreshes the skin surface
How to Use:
 Apply evenly to cleansed face and neck
 Massage gently until fully absorbed
 Use twice daily for best results
Ingredients:
Mandelic Acid, Aqua, Glycerin, Niacinamide, Natural Extracts, Skin-Safe Emollients
Safety Information:
 For external use only
 Avoid direct contact with eyes
 Discontinue if irritation occurs
 Store in a cool, dry place
Package Includes:
 1 × Mandelic Clear Intensely Revitalizing Cream
